flow: ui-path — click the site's own conversation row (first match, or drive gmail_search to locate a subject) and read the opened thread

steps.note: Must run in a logged-in session; otherwise the site 302s to accounts.google.com (measured 2026-09-23).
Optional narrowing: when the caller supplies a subject/query, first run the gmail_search flow so the target thread is on screen; else use the default inbox first row.
Click the site's own row — gmail's own JS opens the thread and renders the message pane. DOM-UNVERIFIED (re-tune on first capture).
Reading the opened pane: subject (h2.hP or .ha), from/date (.gD / .g3), body (.a3s.aXjCH .y2, the rendered email body). DOM-UNVERIFIED.

rpc: none — RPC bridge deliberately not driven; reads off the rendered pane
stealth: real click on the site's own row + DOM read in the user's own logged-in session
